problem: The title says the VM configures Trusted Launch with Secure Boot and vTPM, but the evaluator returns PASS for Standard and ConfidentialVM security types without testing either UEFI switch. Only TrustedLaunch is subject to the switch test.
The title claims Entra app registration, while the evaluator only checks whether identity.type declares a managed identity. It does not inspect an Entra application registration.

The title describes Windows web-server TLS 1.3 enforcement. The evaluator only reads an AuditSecureProtocol guest configuration assignment and its MinimumTLSVersion parameter; it does not inspect live web-server TLS settings.

The check ID implies publicNetworkAccess is disabled, but the evaluator never reads publicNetworkAccess. On vaults with private endpoint connections it only tests networkAcls.defaultAction; vaults with no connections are NOT_APPLICABLE.
The title and remediation suggest a protective WAF mode, but the evaluator returns PASS for either Detection or Prevention. Detection does not block requests.
